newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices extended early gains in late Friday trade as electronics emerged again to lead the upswing, but brokers noted heavy resistance around 8,700 points.
With 50 minutes left, the index was up 86.45 points or 1.00 percent at 8,715.68. Turnover was a brisk T$112 billion.

Electronics, which fell on Thursday, surged 3.07 percent, with chipmaker United Microelectronics up T$2 to T$69.5. "Recent index rises have relied too much on electronics, which are overheated despite their sound profit outlook," said National Securities analyst Alex Yang.
Foods rebounded 2.82 percent after farm officials late on Thursday said a suspected outbreak of a deadly chicken epidemic was only a false alarm.
But financials, which led Thursday's gains, fell slightly.
Several brokers said the index should consolidate between 8,450-8,750 in coming sessions.
